verdict.rationale: Marqeta lets you define rules that are enforced automatically at transaction time. Velocity controls cap spend amount and frequency, authorization controls restrict merchants, and the MCP server exposes spend controls. Beyond that, event-driven automation means receiving webhooks or JIT funding requests on your own endpoint and applying your own business rules there, so there is no native general-purpose rule engine. missing for 10: a native configurable event→action rule engine (e.g., auto card state transitions or notifications on triggers), rule types beyond spend and merchant limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
